body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Reply is Received in Saleshandy (Pipedrive) trigger on Production, 9 checks:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create a Lead, Create a Deal and Create a Person in Pipedrive | New prospect, Mark as replied. One person, with one lead and one deal titled with the prospect name, and one activity (AL-4187). | Pass |
| 2 | Create a Person in Pipedrive | Existing person. The person is updated, there is still one person, and one Email activity is added (AL-4186). | Pass |
| 3 | Update a Person in Pipedrive | Existing person. One done Email activity with the subject "Reply is Received in Saleshandy" is added, and there is still one person (AL-4186). | Pass |
| 4 | Update a Deal in Pipedrive | Person with 2 deals. Only the newest deal changes to Pipeline / Contact Made. The older deal is unchanged. | Pass |
| 5 | Delete Deal in Pipedrive | Person with 2 deals. Only the newest deal is deleted and the older deal stays (AL-4184). | Pass |
| 6 | Delete Person in Pipedrive | The person is deleted. | Pass |
| 7 | Create Organization in Pipedrive | Industry is not in the Pipedrive list. No organization is created (AL-4188). | Pass |
| 8 | Update Organization in Pipedrive | An organization with the exact company name exists. There is still one organization with that name. | Pass |
| 9 | Delete Organization in Pipedrive | An organization with the exact company name exists. The organization is deleted. | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to send from npm run jira. Source: Production smoke of Pipedrive Reply Received on emailopenedprod, 2026-10-30, sequence 987027. All 9 checks Pass. Wording approved by QA in chat, Note removed.
